sentences.text: The genus and species were established by Imran and colleagues in 2026.
The formal description appeared in the Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology and listed Hamzah Imran, David M. Martill, Roy E. Smith, Samir Zouhri, James Gunn, and Nizar Ibrahim as authors.
Ctenosuchus is known from two specimens that preserve parts of the skull and rows of armored plates called osteoderms.
Fossils have been recovered from the Anoual Formation in Morocco.
Its interlocking teeth are interpreted as an adaptation for capturing small crustaceans, fish, and soft-bodied organisms.
Ctenosuchus belongs to the family Teleosauridae, a group of marine crocodyliforms.
The animal lived in the Middle Jurassic, specifically during the Bathonian age.
